title: Reuse the existing active root-only auth runtime and release exact current main
acceptance: only the repository owner can issue the exact release command on release issue 3072
exact current main is resolved and rechecked before protected runtime verification and exact image publication
the protected REG.RU host must be a current live-domain IPv4 answer and present the pinned SSH host fingerprint
the active Compose web container is the runtime authority when PC_PROD_DIR and PC_PROD_COMPOSE secrets are absent
the existing root-only password-reset delivery and transactional-mail files must already exist, validate and remain byte-identical during pre-release verification
no credential values, protected paths, raw environment or raw production logs are published
API, web and migration images are published for the same exact current-main SHA before release
production mutation is delegated only to the existing guarded production-full-stack-exact-sha reusable workflow
production remains the existing REG.RU contour and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB
